description: This PHP source file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks' which extracts <style> blocks from input HTML, cleans them using CSSTidy, and stores them in the context for later use. It also includes a top-level function for error handling and a constructor initializing several attribute definitions and a CSSTidy instance.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks
classes.description: A filter class that extracts CSS <style> blocks from HTML input, cleans and scopes CSS using CSSTidy, and stores them in the context for later use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes attribute definitions for CSS and HTML IDs, sets up CSSTidy with configuration, and prepares scope lists.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Removes <style> blocks from HTML, extracts CSS for cleaning, and registers extracted style blocks in context.

methods.name: cleanCSS
methods.description: Takes CSS code, optionally scopes it, removes comments, parses and cleans it with CSSTidy, and escapes special characters if configured.

methods.name: styleCallback
methods.description: Callback function to collect CSS code snippets from <style> tags during regex matching.
